# Pies & Bars
Pies and bars are a great way to fix desserts for a group of people, and to make use of fresh ingredients you have.
Dough is mixed rather than cooked, then cut and rolled - see [textlink="Doughs & Reactions" link="TP14GuideEntryReactions"] and [textlink="Cutting & Utensils" link="TP14GuideEntryUtensils"].
